features.title: Existing OpenAI Dot text adapter (unofficial)
features.summary: A Host-only, separately AGPL-3.0-only adapter registers on the neutral v1 Bots registry, links the existing primary Dot through exact account-bound DM discovery, polls since-link text updates every three seconds and reconciles stable UUID sends without duplicating unknown delivery.

configuration.constraints: Required canonical credential-port secret reference; no raw access token or implicit environment fallback.
Required canonical renewable session secret reference; no raw value, extraction or automatic vault write.

failureModes: Raw credentials, extra configuration fields, malformed token binding, mismatched Dot/thread/room/account or unknown message authors fail closed.
403 or provider browser challenge stops without bypass, impersonation, proxy rotation or browser extraction.
Nonadvancing or malformed pagination retains the checkpoint; an incomplete reconciliation scan is unknown, not absent.
Transport failure, malformed send acknowledgment or mismatched sender/request identity never justifies a new automatic POST.
Renewal must preserve account, user and account-user mapping. Rotated credentials remain memory-only and reconnect resolves the original vault references again.
Unsupported media or elicitation yields a safe notice/native ChatGPT handoff; no attachments, inline approvals, activity or WebSocket capability is advertised.

externalDependencies.boundary: Pinned AGPL protocol source port: client.go, connector/login.go, connector/client.go and inspected chatgpt/signals.go; no Go/Matrix runtime dependency.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/adapter.test.ts uses synthetic account/member/token fixtures and a scripted Fetch boundary, never an account or authenticated network call.

externalDependencies.id: https://chatgpt.com private messaging and auth endpoints
externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed HTTPS path allowlist only; redirects rejected, 15-second request timeout, bounded response bodies and zod decoding; broad credentials stay in Host memory.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/adapter.test.ts exercises discovery, send, pagination, auth renewal, identity changes and error redaction with local Response fixtures.

externalDependencies.boundary: Canonical reference parsing/Host-only resolver bundled in Host; public built BotAdapter module remains runtime external.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/adapter.test.ts injects a reference resolver and registers the adapter on the real neutral registry.

verification.testName: registers v1 with a neutral registry and honest unsupported capabilities
sends the same UUID in both stable request fields and preserves user authorship
requests limit=32 and after, normalizes chronological distinct authors with safe unsupported handoff
finds request across bounded history from original persisted baseline (not discovery baseline)
reports unknown for incomplete history, repeated cursors and scan budget exhaustion
refreshes on 401 in memory, applies only session cookie at auth endpoint and reuses stable UUID
replays edited and deleted recently-seen stable IDs with deletion time and bounded overlap
bounds malformed JSON, advertised length and streaming bodies without exposing payloads
registers through the real Cordis Host lifecycle and unregisters on disposal without credentials
